result.summary: Found 1 issue: a promo discount badge shows an implausible −100% value that looks like incorrect or broken content.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card displays a −100% badge, which reads as a 100% discount (free item) and looks like incorrect or leftover promotional data rather than a realistic offer.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount source and show a valid percentage or a clearer label (e.g. a named deal) so the badge does not appear broken or misleading.
